en_title: Fox News Talked About GTA 6, and It Went as Well as You'd Expect
cn_title: Fox News谈起了《GTA6》，结果一如你所料
opus_summary: Fox News节目《Fox & Friends》讨论《GTA6》时，主持人Rachel Campos-Duffy表示，这款游戏对文化和社会没有好处，并称角色Lucia是性工作者。文章指出，目前没有迹象表明Lucia有这一背景，游戏将于本周四发售。

paragraphs.en: Fox News and video games — I am sure the very mention of these two things together is enough to send a chill down your spine if you are of a certain age. Back in the '00s, Fox was at the forefront of the campaign against games, whether they were deemed too violent or, in Mass Effect's case, too raunchy .
paragraphs.cn: Fox News和电子游戏——我敢肯定，如果你到了某个年纪，光是把这两样东西放在一起提及，就足以让你脊背发凉。早在21世纪头十年，Fox就站在反游戏运动的最前沿，无论游戏是被认为过于暴力，还是像《质量效应》那样被认为过于色情。

paragraphs.en: Turns out, all of these years later, not much has changed. Grand Theft Auto 6 came up on Fox & Friends over the weekend as we get into launch week, and we got the classics: misinformation and moral panics.
paragraphs.cn: 事实证明，时隔这么多年，情况并没有太大变化。随着我们进入发售周，《GTA6》在周末的《Fox & Friends》节目中被提及，而我们又看到了那些经典桥段：错误信息和道德恐慌。

paragraphs.en: As one of the hosts was reading off some of GTA 6's gameplay, such as talking to NPCs and petting dogs — stuff that isn't exactly unique to the game — another host, Rachel Campos-Duffy, interjected, saying she had to "push back" against it.
paragraphs.cn: 一名主持人正在列举《GTA6》的一些玩法，比如与NPC交谈和抚摸狗——这些并不是什么该游戏独有的内容——另一名主持人Rachel Campos-Duffy插话说，她必须对此「提出反对」。

paragraphs.en: "I really am gonna say I'm not thinking this is a good thing for our culture and society," Campos-Duffy noted. "But let's see what you think after it comes out."
paragraphs.cn: Campos-Duffy说道：「我真的得说，我不认为这对我们的文化和社会是件好事。不过等它出来之后，看看你怎么想吧。」

paragraphs.en: The other host then continued to list the features in GTA 6, pointing out that you can play as both Jason and Lucia. Campos-Duffy piped up again when Lucia is namedropped, and says, "She's a hooker."
paragraphs.cn: 另一名主持人随后继续列举《GTA6》的特色，指出玩家可以分别扮演Jason和Lucia。提到Lucia的名字时，Campos-Duffy又插话说：「她是个妓女。」

paragraphs.en: It was then clarified that Lucia is a "partner in crime" to Jason, but that you could maybe play her to go "straight," moving away from the life.
paragraphs.cn: 随后有人澄清说，Lucia是Jason的「犯罪搭档」，但玩家或许可以让她「改邪归正」，远离那种生活。

paragraphs.en: For obvious reasons, the claim that Lucia is a sex worker has the most attention here. It would, of course, not be a problem if that is part of her backstory, but there's been no indication of that, so it's unclear what made Campos-Duffy jump to that conclusion. Given that this is Fox News, it is also fair to assume that they're not coming at this from a feminist angle, more so fearful about the prospect of sex being in this game. Which it almost definitely will be, based on what we know so far.
paragraphs.cn: 出于显而易见的原因，Lucia是性工作者的说法在这里最受关注。当然，如果这是她背景故事的一部分，也不会有什么问题，但目前没有任何迹象表明这一点，所以不清楚是什么让Campos-Duffy贸然得出了这个结论。鉴于这是Fox News，我们也有理由认为，他们并不是从女权主义的角度看待这个问题，而是更担心这款游戏中可能出现性内容。根据我们目前所知，游戏中几乎肯定会有这些内容。

paragraphs.en: In any case, GTA 6 drops this Thursday. We will be able to see for ourselves if this is really as damaging to culture and society as Fox News fears.
paragraphs.cn: 无论如何，《GTA6》将在本周四发售。届时我们可以亲自看看，它是否真的像Fox News担心的那样对文化和社会有害。
